pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, stellate-like dark patches with jagged, high-angularity edges. Pixel gradients at edges are sharp. Patch spatial area is larger on the upper flank and becomes more fragmented and smaller toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-pelage pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tripartite. Pathway thickness is relatively narrow and consistent across the mid-flank, with high continuity throughout the visible region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background, tapering in visibility towards the shoulder region.

other_distinctive_markers: A small dark avian silhouette (oxpecker) is visible on the lower neck/chest area, creating a localized disruption in the observed pelage pattern.
